case_title.quote: STATE OF MAHARASHTRA v. SYED UMAR SAYED ABBAS & ORS.

number_of_accused.quote: The State of Maharashtra has filed these appeals against the acquittal of Accused Nos. I, 3, 4, 9 and 12.
number_of_accused.reason: Five accused are before the Court.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment does not state the gender of the accused.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated.

accused_religion.reason: No religion is stated; names should not be used to infer it.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Nothing on the accused's wealth or class.

victim_gender.quote: opened fire on Rajendra Rajaram Gupta
victim_gender.reason: The deceased is a male, Rajendra Rajaram Gupta.

victim_age.reason: No age is given for the victim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: two unknown persons entered the Panda!
accused_victim_relationship.reason: No relationship is described; the assailants are called unknown.

offence_category.reason: Murder is the main offence charged.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.302, 307, 120B r/w s.34; Arms Act ss.25, 27, 29
statutory_provisions.correct_value_note: s.34 is charged only with 120B per page 4
statutory_provisions.quote: under Sections 302, 307, 120B read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ... and Sections 25, 27, and 29 of the Arms Act, 1959
statutory_provisions.reason: Provisions are right; the 'r/w s.34' grouping is the judgment's own wording, so only minor imprecision.

weapon.quote: opened fire on Rajendra Rajaram Gupta and pumped many bullets

evidence_type.quote: it was conclusively established by the Test Identification Parade and eye-witness testimonies ... recovery of the weapon along with the ballistic report
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, TIP, recovery, ballistic and post-mortem evidence are all mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: pumped many bullets in his head, chest and various parts of his body at point blank range

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted Accused Nos.1, 3, 4, 9 and .12 for offences punishable under Sections 302 and 307 read with Section 120-B

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court allowed the criminal appeals filed by the respondents herein and acquitted them

final_outcome.quote: we find no grounds to interfere with the judgment passed by the High Court. The appeals are, accordingly, dismissed.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence results from the acquittal.

imprisonment_years.reason: No sentence, so null is right.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove 'On a Saturday', 'about an hour and a quarter later' and 'roughly a year or more after' as inferences; remove the reference to the post-mortem finding of the victim being attacked from behind unless framed as evidence.
neutral_facts.quote: on 12.8. I 995, at about 3.00 P.M. ... The FIR came to be immediately lodged at 4: 15 P.M.
neutral_facts.reason: The weekday 'Saturday' is not in the judgment; the rest is largely accurate. The text also hints at weaknesses in the evidence.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the prescribed punishment.

attempt_completion.reason: Death occurred, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: while PW6 tried to run, he was also hit by one bullet

number_of_offences.correct_value: 6 charged (IPC ss.302, 307, 120B; Arms Act ss.25, 27, 29); 0 finally upheld
number_of_offences.quote: Sections 302, 307, 120B read with Section 34 ... Sections 25, 27, and 29 of the Arms Act
number_of_offences.reason: The count of 7 includes s.34, which is a rule of joint liability rather than a distinct offence; the correct count of distinct offences is 6.

premeditation_planning.reason: The Court made no finding on planning.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: the testimonies of the witnesses suffer various infirmities and contradictions

witness_credibility.quote: PW7 did not identify any of the accused/ respondents in the Test Identification Parade
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the assessment of each witness.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Assailants escaping is noted, but no specific accused conduct is found; 'Not stated' is acceptable, if slightly incomplete.

legal_representation.quote: Kuna] A. Cheema, Addi. Govt. Adv., Nishant Ramakantrao Katneshwarkar for the Appellant. Mushtaq Ahmad for the Respondents.

investigation_status.quote: charges were framed against I 3 accused persons

procedural_irregularity.quote: the Test Identification Parade was not conducted properly and was delayed

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State reiterated that the Trial Court judgment was well reasoned and well considered.
prosecution_argument.quote: reiterated that the judgment of the Trial Court is well reasoned and well considered
prosecution_argument.reason: Only the first point is the State's argument in the SC; the rest is the trial court's reasoning.

defence_argument.quote: relying upon the judgment of the High Court pressing that ... the prosecution could not bring home the charges
defence_argument.reason: Plus the Siddanki Ram Reddy citation on delayed TIP.

legal_principle_applied.quote: any delay in holding the test identification parade may be held to be fatal to the prosecution case

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Siddanki Ram Reddy v. State of An<lhra Pradesh, [(2010) 7 SCC 697]
